blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Large language models (LLMs) can generate accurate responses, but these are void of diversity.
We attempt to address this for the task of creative short story generation. Drawing on established writing conventions and known LLM limitations, we target variation in genre, tone, style, and named entities. To promote diversity across these dimensions, we introduce DivLM , an LLM post-training framework consisting of two phases. First, we perform continued pre-training on a creative writing corpus and restore instruction-following capabilities using weight residuals. We then apply reinforcement learning with a custom, composite reward function that jointly maximizes diversity across the targeted narrative dimensions while maintaining response quality.
Our empirical results on two LLM families show that DivLM increases diversity metrics by more than 9% on average compared to alternative approaches, while preserving instruction following, overall response quality, and similarity to human outputs. Source code: github.com/ZahraSolatiDehkordi/DivLM

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) have significantly improved in their ability to follow instructions and produce accurate and helpful responses. These advances have led to growing interest in using LLMs for creative writing and storytelling ( Pei et al., 2024 ; Venkatraman et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Liu et al., 2024 ) . However, prior studies show that while LLM assistance can increase the perceived creativity of individual human-authored texts, it reduces the collective diversity of content produced by groups of writers ( Doshi and Hauser, 2024 ; Padmakumar and He, 2024 ) . This concern is consistent with evidence that LLMs often exhibit limited diversity across repeated generations from the same or similar prompts ( Li et al., 2025b ; Chakrabarty et al., 2024 ; Chu et al., 2025 ; Yun et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Xu et al., 2025 ) . This low diversity is largely attributed to the post-training process, where LLMs are trained using methods such as instruction tuning and reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) to increase output quality and alignment. This can narrow a model’s output distribution toward high-reward or typical responses ( Padmakumar and He, 2024 ; Yun et al., 2025 ; Kirk et al., 2024 ) . Such distributional narrowing can lead to mode collapse, where a model repeatedly generates outputs from a limited subset of plausible responses ( Hamilton, 2024 ) . This limitation is particularly important in creative writing workflows, where users often rely on LLMs to explore a space of possible ideas.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMS)在遵循指令和产生准确而有帮助的响应的能力上得到显著提高. 这些进步导致人们越来越有兴趣使用LLMs进行创造性的写作和讲故事(Pei等,2024;Venkatraman等,2025;Wang等,2025a;Liu等,2024)。 然而,先前的研究表明,虽然LLM援助可以提高个人作者文本的想象创造力,但它降低了作者群体制作内容的集体多样性(Doshi and Hauser, 2024; Padmakumar and He, 2024.). 这一关切与以下证据是一致的:LLMS在重复的几代人中往往表现出有限的多样性,而这种多样性来自相同或类似的诱因(Li等,2025年b;Chakrabarty等,1925年b)。 2024;Chu等,2025;Yun等,2025;Wang等,2025b;徐等,2025. 这种低程度的多样性主要归因于培训后进程,即利用诸如从人类反馈(RLHF)中进行指导调整和强化学习等方法培训法学硕士,以提高产出质量和一致性。 这可以将模型的输出分布缩小为高回报或典型反应(Padmakumar和He,2024;Yun等,2025;Kirk等,2024)。 这种分布式收缩可能导致模式倒闭,即一个模式从有限的一组可信反应中反复产生输出(Hamilton, 2024 ). 这种限制在创造性的写作工作流程中特别重要,用户经常依靠LLMS来探索可能的想法空间.

A common way to encourage more varied outputs is to increase sampling stochasticity through decoding methods such as temperature scaling. However, prior work has found that such methods do not necessarily improve diversity while coherence or quality drops ( Peeperkorn et al., 2024 ; Chu et al., 2025 ) . Other existing approaches include prompt-based Wang et al. (2025b) ; Chu et al. (2025) ; Zhang et al. (2026a) or post-training Lanchantin et al. (2025) ; Li et al. (2025c) ; Li et al. (2025b) ; Yao et al. (2025) ; Chung et al. (2025) ; Chen et al. (2026) methods. Our work rather improves the diversity of already post-trained models.
Specifically, we focus on short story generation and adopt a broad view of diversity that considers higher-level narrative decisions. Figure 1 illustrates why this broader view is necessary. Generations may differ in
surface details, but maintain
the same underlying narrative trajectory and other high-level attributes.
We define diverse short story generation as the task of producing a set of high-quality stories for a single prompt such that they differ along salient narrative dimensions. This moves past conventional single-output generation, where the objective is to produce one fluent and instruction-following response. To reinforce this set property,
we propose an optimization process that is based on specific group-level rewards computed over multiple generations for the same prompt. This diversification methodology is captured by a two-phase training framework; we refer to it as Div ersified L anguage M odel or DivLM . First, we perform continued pre-training on creative writing data to strengthen the model’s domain-specific generative capabilities. Then, we apply reinforcement learning with carefully curated group-level rewards that encourage diversity while preserving basic output quality. Our approach promotes diversity over story-level attributes (genre, style, tone, named entities) and maintains typical quality standards. Empirically, we find that optimizing story-level diversity improves not only the targeted attributes, but also embedding-based semantic distance.
Our main contributions are summarized as follows: 1. We propose a two-phase training framework ( DivLM ) that combines continued pre-training on creative writing data with reinforcement learning based on group-level diversity rewards. 2. We introduce a composite reward formulation that promotes diversity over story-level attributes, including genre, style, tone, and named entities, while maintaining basic output quality. 3. Our analysis introduces novel metrics for quantifying diversity in LLM outputs. These go beyond cosine distance and are better tailored for the specificity of the short story generation task. 4. Our extensive experiments showcase that DivLM yields significant gains on diversity performance while maintaining response quality.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Prior work on LLM diversity can be broadly divided into methods applied during either model training or inference. The latter encourage diverse generations without updating model parameters, either by changing the decoding procedure or by modifying the prompt. Decoding-based approaches modify the token selection process during generation, aiming to avoid overly deterministic or repetitive outputs while preserving relevance and coherence Franceschelli and Musolesi (2025) ; Troshin et al. (2025) .
Prompt-based approaches instead induce diversity by changing the input context or task framing Wang et al. (2025b) ; Chu et al. (2025) ; Zhang et al. (2026a) .
While these methods intervene at inference time to induce more varied outputs, they do not directly modify the model’s learned generation behavior.
Training-time methods, on the other hand, incorporate diversity as an auxiliary objective during post-training procedures such as fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and preference optimization. These approaches differ in how they define the diversity signal. One line of work uses lexical or token-level proxies, encouraging variation in surface form or in the model’s token distribution Li et al. (2025c) ; Lanchantin et al. (2025) ; Yao et al. (2025) .
A second line of work measures diversity in a semantic representation space, encouraging generated responses to be farther apart according to embedding-based criteria Li et al. (2025b) ; Chung et al. (2025) ; Chen et al. (2026) .
These approaches move beyond lexical variation, but they typically compress diversity into a single semantic distance or equivalence signal. The most closely aligned work to ours uses reinforcement learning to encourage more diverse selections Anschel et al. (2025) . Here, diversity is defined over the distribution of selected options rather than over token choices or embedding distances between free-form generations.

blocks.en: Despite this progress, existing diversity objectives remain limited for creative writing. Lexical and token-level metrics primarily capture surface variation, while embedding-based distances often collapse distinct creative dimensions into a single semantic similarity score. As a result, these approaches do not fully capture aspects of diversity that are central to creative generation. Moreover, much of the training-time literature focuses on preserving the base model’s diversity during post-training, whereas our work treats diversity as the primary target for improvement.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,但现有的多样性目标在创造性写作方面仍然有限。 语法和符号级的度量法主要捕捉出地表变异,而嵌入基距离往往会将不同的创意维度崩溃成一个单一的语义相近分. 因此,这些方法不能充分体现多样性中对于创造力至关重要的方面。 此外,许多培训时间的文献都侧重于在培训后保留基本模式的多样性,而我们的工作将多样性视为改进的主要目标。

blocks.en: 4 Improving Diversity in Creative Writing with DivLM
blocks.zh: 4 与DivLM一起改善创造性写作的多样性

blocks.en: The proposed methodology ( DivLM ) consists of two phases (Figure 2 ). First, we perform continued pre-training to strengthen the model’s foundational capabilities in creative writing. We then apply reinforcement learning to encourage greater output diversity while maintaining core requirements such as prompt adherence and completeness.
blocks.zh: 拟议方法(DivLM)包括两个阶段(图2)。 首先,我们继续进行预训,以加强模型的创作基础能力。 然后,我们采用强化学习方法,鼓励更大的产出多样性,同时维持诸如迅速遵守和完整性等核心要求。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of DivLM , our proposed framework for improving diversity in short story generation, consisting of the CPT (section 4.1 ) and RL (section 4.2 ) phases.
blocks.zh: 图2:DivLM概览,我们提议的在短篇故事生成中改善多样性的框架,包括CPT(第4.1节)和RL(第4.2节)阶段。

blocks.en: 4.1 Continued Pre-training For Creative Writing (CPT Phase)
blocks.zh: 4.1 继续开展创意写作前培训(CPT阶段)

blocks.en: The objective of this phase is to expose the model to diverse creative writing examples so that it can more effectively generate varied and imaginative outputs in subsequent tasks. This will also enhance the effectiveness of reinforcement learning (section 4.2 ) which depends on the capacity of the base model ( Guo et al., 2025 ) and can attain an enhanced performance ceiling via domain-specific continued pre-training ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . Hence, we devise a domain-specific corpus (denoted by 𝒞 \mathcal{C} ) that consists of creative writing texts curated to encourage stylistic flexibility and narrative variety (section 5.1 ).
blocks.zh: 这个阶段的目标是让模型接触到各种创造性的写作实例,以便它能更有效地在以后的任务中产生多种多样和富有想象力的产出. 这也将提高强化学习的有效性(第4.2节),这取决于基准模型的能力(Guo等,2025年),并能通过特定领域的持续预训(Liu等,2025年)达到更高的性能上限。 因此,我们设计了一个专有域(由C\mathcal{C}注解),由创造性的书写文本组成,鼓励风格的灵活性和叙事性(第5.1节)。

In our experiments, we perform continued pre-training using a low-rank adapter (LoRA), keeping the underlying model weights fixed ( Hu et al., 2022 ) .
In line with standard practice, this is applied to the pretrained base model ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2025 ) . This process does not retain the instruction-following behavior of the instruction-tuned model ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , and hence these capabilities must be subsequently restored. (2025) : Δ ​ θ = θ inst − θ base . \Delta\theta=\theta_{\text{inst}}-\theta_{\text{base}}\,. Finally, Δ ​ θ \Delta\theta is added back to the updated parameters to recover the instruction-following behavior. According to our empirical analysis, an important design choice is to determine the proportion of Δ ​ θ \Delta\theta that should be applied in order to recover instruction-following capabilities while preserving the diversity gains achieved during continued pre-training. We introduce a tunable scaling parameter s ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] s\!\in\![0,1] to control this. blocks.en: This design naturally induces a form of curriculum learning ( Bengio et al., 2009 ) . Early in training, when outputs are more likely to fall below the threshold, the model optimizes a simpler objective focused on quality. As it learns to consistently exceed the threshold, the objective expands to include diversity, resulting in a richer optimization target. This staged objective decomposition is consistent with recent approaches in which prerequisite behaviors are learned before more complex objectives are optimized within the same training pipeline ( Gao et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 这种设计自然诱发出一种课程学习形式(Bengio等,2009.). 在培训初期,当产出更可能低于门槛值时,该模式优化了注重质量的更简单的目标。 随着它学会持续地超过阈值,目标会扩大至包括多样性,从而产生更丰富的优化目标. 这种分阶段的目标分解符合最近的做法,即在同一培训管道内优化更复杂的目标之前,必须先了解先决条件行为(Gao等,2024;Jiang等,2025)。

blocks.en: We use two open-source instruction-tuned models, Llama-3.1-8B ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) and Gemma-2-9B ( Gemma Team, 2024 ) . We first describe the datasets and evaluation metrics, then analyze the effects of the two training phases (CPT and RL) as well as provide further insights via ablation.
blocks.zh: 我们使用两个开源指令调制模型 Llama -3.1 -8B (Grattafiori等,2024年)和Gemma-2-9B (Gemma Team,2024年). 我们首先描述数据集和评价衡量标准,然后分析两个培训阶段(CPT和RL)的效果,并通过淡化提供进一步的见解。

blocks.en: 5.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 5.1 数据集

blocks.en:
For the CPT phase (Section 4.1 ), we constructed an 18M-token corpus consisting of long-form creative writing from Project Gutenberg 1 1 1 Project Gutenberg, gutenberg.org and BookCorpus ( Zhu et al., 2015 ) . Original corpora from both resources include full-length novels or stories across multiple genres and historical periods.
To transform this material into a high-quality training corpus, we deployed a multi-stage curation pipeline consisting of language filtering, toxicity screening, and deduplication (see Appendix C.1 ). For the RL phase (Section 4.2 ) as well as for the evaluation of all methods, we use the WritingPrompts dataset that contains human-written prompts and short stories ( Fan et al., 2018 ) . Original data consists of posts (used as prompts) and their associated comments, each one being a story. Each prompt or story has a score that reflects community reception, calculated as the sum of all upvotes and downvotes received from community members. We filtered the dataset based on this score. Additionally, we removed prompts with high semantic similarity, and applied balanced sampling across implied genres, styles, and tones (see also Appendix C.2 ).

关于CPT阶段(第4.1节),我们建造了由Gutenberg 1 1 1号项目Gutenberg 1号项目Gutenberg.org和BookCorpus(Zhu等,2015年)的长式创造性书写体组成的18M-托肯体。 这两种资源的原生子公司包括全长小说或跨越多流派和历史时期的故事.
为了将这些材料转化为高质量的培训教材,我们部署了由语言过滤、毒性筛选和分解组成的多阶段矫正管道(见附录C.1)。 对于RL阶段(第4.2节)以及对所有方法的评价,我们使用包含由人写的提示和短篇故事(Fan et al., 2018.)的写作Prompts数据集. 原始数据包括文章(用作提示)及其相关评论,每篇都是故事. 每个即时或故事都有反映社区接收的分数,以社区成员收到的所有高票和低票的总和来计算. 我们根据这个分数过滤了数据集. 此外,我们删除了语义相似度高的提示,并在隐含的流派、风格和音调之间采用了平衡的抽样(另见附录C.2)。

blocks.en: 5.3 Evaluation Metrics and Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: 5.3 评价计量和实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate generated outputs using metrics that quantify quality and diversity. All metrics are in the range of [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . Diversity metrics are computed at the output group level ( G G outputs for each prompt). We report both the RL reward and the coverage of genre, tone, and style. Coverage is defined as the average proportion of subtypes that are present in each group of outputs. We also report the named entity reward score. To compare with a conventional baseline metric, we include the average pairwise cosine distance between the embeddings of the outputs in each group. To ensure consistency with the scales of the other metrics, we rescale cosine similarity from [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] and derive cosine distance from the rescaled values, resulting in a cosine distance scale of [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] .
Quality metrics are computed at the individual output level. They include prompt adherence, meta-commentary rate, completeness, and coherence (see Appendix D ).

We also provide comparisons with other methods from the literature, namely Diversity Quality Optimization (DQO; Chen et al., 2026 ) and Diversified Direct Preference Optimization (DDPO; Chung et al., 2025 ) using our datasets and Llama-3.1-8B (see Appendix H ).

blocks.en: CPT models outperform INS models across all diversity metrics. Prompt adherence and coherence remain comparable, while completeness decreases substantially, resulting in a lower average quality score. These results suggest that while CPT broadens the model’s output distribution, the subsequent reinforcement learning phase is necessary to recover output quality.
blocks.zh: CPT模型在所有多样性衡量标准上都超过了INS模型. 迅速遵守和一致性仍然是可比的,而完整性则会大幅下降,导致平均质量分数降低。 这些结果表明,虽然CPT扩大了模型的输出分布,但随后的强化学习阶段对于恢复出产质量是必要的.

blocks.en: DivLM models yield quality metrics that remain close to those of the INS models, while completeness improves substantially. All diversity metrics improve. RL rewards respectively increase on average by 86.5% and 42% for Llama and Gemma compared to their INS baselines; respective gains over CPT are 23.7% and 9.7%. Smaller gains for Gemma may be partly due the fact that the hyperparameters were only optimized for Llama. 3 3 3 To accommodate experiments under tight computational cost (GPU hours) constraints.

blocks.en: Nevertheless, the consistent improvement observed for Gemma suggests that the approach transfers across model families. A similar pattern of gains is observed in the coverage metrics, where CPT improves INS by 23.23% and DivLM improves over CPT by 20.65%.
blocks.zh: 然而,对Gemma的一贯改进表明,这一办法在模范家庭之间转移。 在覆盖度衡量标准中也观察到类似的增益模式,即欧洲防止酷刑委员会将INS改进23.23%,DivLM比欧洲防止酷刑委员会改进20.65%。

blocks.en: The cosine distance also increases, which indicates greater semantic variation despite not being directly optimized during training. The human-written stories associated with the test prompts have an average cosine distance of .297. Relative to this human reference, the Llama INS model achieves 42.1% of the observed semantic variation, while Llama DivLM reaches 76.2%; for Gemma, this increases from 41.8% to 60.4%. Hence, DivLM substantially narrows the gap between human and LLM-generated outputs.

blocks.en: From the baselines, the DQO model achieves high output quality, with an average score of .983. Compared with the INS model, it exhibits greater genre diversity and cosine distance but lower tone and named entity diversity. In contrast, the DDPO model improves across all diversity metrics relative to the INS model and achieves the highest cosine distance among all evaluated models. However, these gains come at a substantial cost to output quality, with DDPO obtaining the lowest average quality score of .534 and a completeness rate of only .017. Compared to DQO, DivLM improves quality by 0.71%, genre/tone/style coverage by an average of 50.34%, and diversity rewards by 85.53%. The respective gains compared to DDPO are 85.39%, 8.91%, and 10.50%.
blocks.zh: 从基线来看,DQO模型实现了高产出质量,平均得分为983. 与INS模型相比,它表现出了更大的流派多样性和同位素距离,但基调较低并被命名为实体多样性. 相形之下,DDPO模型相对于INS模型改进了所有多样性的度量标准,在所有被评价模型中实现了最高的同位素距离. 然而,这些收益对产出质量来说成本很高,DDPO的平均质量得分最低为534分,完整性只有0.017分. 与DQO相比,DivLM的质量提高了0.71%,流派/通/型覆盖率平均提高了50.34%,多样性奖励提高了85.53%. 与DDPO相比,相应的收益分别为85.39%、8.91%和10.50%。

blocks.en: The GRPO-only model marginally achieves the highest average quality score. This can be explained by the fact that training begins directly from the INS model, which already has strong quality performance, and the GRPO-only model primarily needs to improve completeness and reduce meta-commentary. However, GRPO-only produces the smallest diversity gain among the trained variants, increasing the average diversity reward by only 18.3% relative to the INS baseline. This indicates that GRPO can improve diversity without CPT, but its effect is limited when optimization begins from the more constrained INS model. Our interpretation is that CPT expands the set of responses available to the model, giving GRPO a broader space of trajectories for optimization.
blocks.zh: GRPO唯一模式略微达到最高平均质量分. 其原因是培训直接从已经具有很强质量性能的INS模式开始,而只使用GRPO的模式主要需要提高完整性并减少元参数. 然而,只有GRPO在经过培训的变种中产生的多样性收益最小,相对于INS基线,平均多样性奖励只增加了18.3%。 这表明GRPO可以在没有CPT的情况下改善多样性,但当从较为受约束的INS模型开始优化时,其效果是有限的. 我们的解释是,CPT扩展了模型可用的一组响应,为GRPO提供了更广阔的优化轨道空间.

blocks.en: The DLM cos {}_{\text{cos}} baseline improves average diversity rewards by 28.6% relative to the INS model and achieves the highest semantic distance among all variants, as expected from its training objective. However, its average diversity reward remains below that of its CPT initialization. In particular, its tone and style rewards decrease substantially, suggesting that optimizing semantic distance alone does not reliably improve the broader range of diversity dimensions captured by our reward. Notably, the semantic distance achieved by this model is only 1.7% higher than that of our final model. This indicates that, despite not directly optimizing cosine distance, our model achieves comparable semantic variation while substantially improving diversity across the broader set of target dimensions.
blocks.zh: DLM cos QQtext{cos} 基线比 INS 模型提高了28.6%的平均多样性奖励,并实现了所有变体中最高的语义距离,正如其培训目标所预期的那样. 然而,其平均多样性奖励仍低于欧洲防止酷刑委员会初始化奖励。 特别是,它的语气和风格奖励大大地减少了,这表明仅靠最优化的语义距离并不能可靠地改善我们奖励所抓住的更广泛的多样性层面。 值得注意的是,这个模型实现的语义距离仅比我们最终模型高1.7%. 这表明,尽管没有直接优化同位素距离,但我们的模型实现了可比较的语义差异,同时大大地改善了更广泛的目标层面的多样性。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: This work addresses the limited diversity of LLM outputs in short story generation, with a focus on four narrative dimensions, namely genre, tone, style, and named entities. We introduce DivLM , a two-phase post-training framework that combines CPT with diversity-focused RL. In the CPT phase, we train the model on a creative writing corpus and use weight residuals to transfer instruction-following capabilities. We observe that the proportion of the residuals added controls the trade-off between output diversity and quality. During RL, we optimize the model using a custom composite reward that encourages variation across the four narrative dimensions while maintaining overall response quality. Our results show that DivLM improves diversity significantly both over the instruct model variant as well as competitive alternative approaches. Further analysis highlights the complementary roles of the two training phases, wherein CPT broadens the model’s output distribution, providing RL with a richer trajectory space to explore and optimize.
blocks.zh: 这部作品解决了短篇故事一代中LLM产出的有限多样性,重点是四个叙事层面,即流派,语气,风格和被命名的实体. 我们引入了DivLM, 将欧洲防止酷刑委员会与注重多样性的RL相结合的两阶段培训后框架。 在CPT阶段,我们用创造性的书写体来培训模型,并利用重量后遗症来转移教学跟踪能力. 我们注意到,增加的剩余部分的比例控制了产出多样性与质量之间的取舍。 在RL期间,我们利用定制的复合奖励来优化模型,鼓励在保持总体反应质量的同时,在四个叙事层面出现差异. 我们的结果表明,DivLM在指示性模型变体和竞争性替代方法上都大大提高了多样性。 进一步的分析突出了两个培训阶段的互补作用,欧洲防止酷刑委员会扩大了模型的产出分布,为研究与优化提供了更丰富的轨道空间。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: This study focuses exclusively on short story generation and does not experiment with other forms of creative writing, such as long-form stories and extended role-playing sessions. These tasks introduce additional requirements such as narrative continuity and long-term memory, which may interact with diversity in ways that are not captured by our current evaluation framework. Future work could investigate whether the proposed training approach remains effective in longer and more interactive generation settings, and extend the reward design to consider these additional dimensions.
blocks.zh: 本研究专注短篇故事生成,不实验其他创作形式,如长篇故事和扩展角色扮演会. 这些任务带来了叙述连续性和长期记忆等额外要求,这些要求可能以我们目前的评价框架所没有的方式与多样性相互作用。 今后的工作可以调查拟议培训方法在较长和更互动的一代环境中是否仍然有效,并扩展奖励设计,以考虑这些额外的层面。

blocks.en: Due to computational and memory constraints, our experiments are limited to models with at most 9B parameters. Evaluating DivLM on larger models would provide a more complete understanding of its effectiveness and generalizability.
blocks.zh: 由于计算和内存的限制,我们的实验仅限于最多有9B参数的模型. 对更大的模型进行DivLM的评价,将使人们更全面地了解其有效性和普遍性。

blocks.en: Finally, this work addresses output diversity rather than creativity in its broader sense. Diversity involves the degree of variation across generated outputs and represents only one component of creative behavior. Developing reliable methods to evaluate and optimize creativity comprehensively remains an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 最后,这项工作涉及产出的多样性,而不是广义的创造性。 多样性涉及不同产出的差异程度,只是创造性行为的一个组成部分。 制定可靠方法,全面评价和优化创造力,仍然是今后工作的一个重要方向。

blocks.en: Appendix A About Writing Styles
blocks.zh: 附录 A 关于写样式

blocks.en: What we refer to as style is often termed as narrative mode in the creative writing and stylistics literature. Prior work has proposed several taxonomies of fiction-writing modes, which overlap substantially. Selgin (2009) identifies five modes: action, dialogue, thoughts, summary, and description, whereas Morrell (2006) expands to: action, exposition, description, dialogue, summary, and transition. Similarly, Marshall (1998) lists action, summary, dialogue, feelings/thoughts, and background as core modes. These taxonomies consistently distinguish between physical action, spoken dialogue, and narratorial or descriptive exposition, while differing mainly in whether internal thought, exposition, summary, and background information are treated as separate categories. To this end, we have chosen to follow the paradigm of prior work in controllable fiction generation that employs dialogue, action, and description as explicit writing modes ( Zhong et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们所说的"风格"在创造性的写作和文体文学中常被称作叙事模式. 先前的工作提出了若干个小说写作模式的分类,这些模式有很大的重叠. Selgin(2009年)确定了五个模式:行动、对话、思想、总结和描述,而Morrell(2006年)则扩展到:行动、展示、描述、对话、总结和过渡。 同样,马歇尔(1998年)将行动、摘要、对话、感受/想法和背景列为核心模式。 这些分类法一贯区分实际行动、口语对话以及旁白或描述性说明,而主要不同的是,内部思想、解释、摘要和背景资料是否作为单独的类别对待。 为此,我们选择了在可控的虚构一代中遵循先前的工作模式,即采用对话、行动和明确写作模式(Zhong等,2023年)。

blocks.en: Appendix B Construction of Genre, Style, and Tone Dimensions
blocks.zh: 附录B 流派、样式和声调尺寸的构造

blocks.en: We construct the diversity dimensions (genre, style, and tone) to be as mutually distinguishable and semantically orthogonal as possible, while remaining interpretable to both human readers and LLM-based judges. Each dimension consists of a small set of discrete categories designed to support robust LLM judgement and balanced reward allocation.
blocks.zh: 我们构建多样性的维度(流派、风格和语气),以尽可能地相互区分和精准地正统地进行构思,同时仍然可以对人类读者和基于LLM的法官进行解释。 每个层面都由一组小的离散类别组成,旨在支持强有力的LLM判断和平衡的奖励分配.

blocks.en: Genre. The genre categories were derived empirically from an analysis of 10,634 books and their associated genres as reported on the book cataloging website Goodreads. We first removed all non-fiction genres (e.g., philosophy, religion, biography, politics). We then computed pairwise genre overlap and merged categories with high overlap (Jaccard index ≥ 0.2 \geq 0.2 ). Finally, we removed genres that primarily denote demographics or time periods (e.g., young adult, 20th century). The resulting set reflects broad narrative genres with minimal semantic redundancy: fantasy , science fiction , horror , romance , mystery-thriller , literary drama , historical , action-adventure , and other . The other category captures works that do not fit into the preceding genres or exhibit mixed or less common characteristics (e.g., dystopian fiction or magical realism).
blocks.zh: 流相会. 流派分类是从对书目分类网站Goodreads上报告的10,634本书及其相关流派的分析中从经验上推导出来的. 我们首先去除了所有非虚构的流派(如哲学,宗教,传记,政治等). 然后我们计算出双相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 最后,我们删除了主要表示人口统计或时段的流派(如20世纪的年轻成年人). 由此形成的剧集反映了广义的叙事流派,其语义冗余程度极低:幻想;科幻;恐怖;浪漫;神秘;文学剧;历史;动作-冒险;等. 另一类则捕捉出与前作流派不相适应或表现出混合或不太常见特征的作品(例如:dystopian虚构或神奇现实主义).

blocks.en:
Style (Narrative Mode). To reduce overlap and improve robustness of automatic classification by an LLM judge, we collapse the finer-grained distinctions (see Appendix A ) into three broad modes: descriptive , which includes narration, exposition, description, and background; action-focused , emphasizing physical events and movement;
and dialogue-heavy , in which story progression occurs primarily through character speech. This formulation is consistent with prior work in controllable fiction generation, which uses dialogue, action, and description as controllable writing modes ( Zhong et al., 2023 ) . Although individual stories may exhibit elements of multiple modes, each story is assigned a single label that identifies its dominant narrative style.
blocks.zh:
样式( 标记模式) 。 为了减少重叠,改进LLM法官自动分类的力度,我们把细微的区分(见附录A)分解成三大模式:描述,包括叙述、说明、描述和背景;注重行动,强调物理事件和运动;
故事进展主要通过人物演讲进行。 这种提法与以前在可控虚构生成中的工作是一致的,后者使用对话,动作,并描述为可控的写作模式(Zhong等,2023年). 虽然个别故事可能展现出多模式的元素,但每个故事都被分配到一个单一的标签来识别其主导叙事风格.

blocks.en: Tone. We define tone using three categories: humorous , somber , and neutral . Rather than treating humor as a separate genre, we assume that tone is orthogonal to genre, allowing any genre to be expressed in a humorous, somber, or neutral manner.
blocks.zh: 东尼. 我们用三个类别来定义语气:幽默、孤独和中立。 我们不把幽默作为一个单独的流派来看待,而是假设调子对流派是正统的,允许任何流派以幽默,沉闷,或中立的方式表达出.

blocks.en: These dimensions define a compact and interpretable space over which diversity can be enforced, addressing aspects of creative writing that are not always captured by surface-level similarity metrics.
blocks.zh: 这些维度定义了可强制多样性的紧凑和可解释的空间,涉及创作性书写的各个方面,这些方面并不总是被地表水平相似度的衡量标准所抓住.

blocks.en: Appendix C Corpora Preprocessing
blocks.zh: 附录C 公司 预处理

blocks.en: C.1 Creative Writing Dataset
blocks.zh: C.1 创造性写入数据集

blocks.en: To form the dataset for continued pre-training, we first curate the selection of 150 books to ensure a uniform distribution across genres. Books are obtained from both Project Gutenberg and the BookCorpus ( Zhu et al., 2015 ) dataset. We filter the books to retain only the narrative text of the story. We remove front and back matter (e.g., tables of contents), boilerplate (e.g., *** END OF THE PROJECT GUTENBERG EBOOK *** ), illustration markers and captions (e.g., [Illustration] ), and formatting artifacts, such as decorative separators (e.g., ***** ) and layout markers (e.g., /* RIGHT ... */ ). We identify and remove these elements using rule-based pattern matching. The texts are segmented at sentence boundaries into passages of 500-800 tokens, with token counts measured using the Llama-3.1-8B tokenizer. Consecutive sentences are added until adding the next sentence would exceed the 800-token limit. We perform language filtering using the fastText language identification model ( Joulin et al., 2016 ; Joulin et al., 2017 ) and retain only English texts. We apply automated toxicity screening to the BookCorpus dataset using the Detoxify library 4 4 4 Detoxify library, github.com/unitaryai/detoxify to identify passages containing toxic or otherwise unsuitable content. We set the threshold values for explicit, obscene, and toxic content to 0.2, 0.6, and 0.6, respectively. Any passage exceeding these conservative thresholds in the corresponding toxicity dimensions is removed. This process filters out undesirable material without constraining the creative or stylistic diversity of the corpus. This filtering not applied to books from Project Gutenberg. To remove redundant passages while preserving the natural variability of creative writing, we follow the approach of Lee et al. (2022) for deduplication. We use exact matching, substring overlap (via 50-character substrings), edit similarity ( > 0.7 >0.7 ) and Jaccard similarity ( > 0.7 >0.7 ) as primary signals, and add cosine similarity ( > 0.9 >0.9 ) as an additional safeguard for semantic duplicates. Although these thresholds are intentionally strict, the inherent diversity of creative prose means that only 0.6% of passages are removed in this step.
blocks.zh: 为了形成继续预训的数据集,我们首先对150本书的选取进行管理,以确保在各流派之间统一分布。 书籍取自"古腾堡项目"和"BookCorpus"(Zhu等,2015年)数据集. 我们过滤书籍 只保留故事的叙事文本。 我们删除了前部和后部物质(例如目录),锅炉板(例如*** END of the Project GUTENBERG EBOOK ***),插图标记和标题(例如[说明]),以及格式化文物,例如装饰分离器(例如 )和布局标记(例如 / * 右. */)等. 我们使用基于规则的模式匹配来识别并去除这些元素. 文本在句子边界被分出为500-800个令牌的段落,用Llama-3.1-8B符号来测量令牌数. 在增加下一句之前,将增加连续的句子,以超过800个音节的限制。 我们使用快取Text语言识别模式(Joulin等,2016;Joulin等,2017)进行语言过滤,并只保留英文文本. 我们对BookCorpus数据集采用自动毒性筛选方法,使用解毒图书馆4 4 4 解毒图书馆github.com/bodeai/解毒,以识别含有有毒或其他不适宜内容的段落。 我们把明确、淫秽和有毒含量的阈值分别定为0.2、0.6和0.6。 在相应的毒性维度上超过这些保守阈值的任何通道被去除. 这一过程过滤出不受欢迎的材料,而不限制本体的创造性或结构多样性。 这种过滤不适用于来自"古腾堡计划"的书籍. 为了去除冗余的段落,同时保留创造性写作的自然可变性,我们遵循了李等(2022年)的分化方法. 我们使用精确的匹配,下弦相重叠(通过50-字符串),编辑相似性( > 0.7 > 0.7)和Jaccard相类似性( > 0.7 > 0.7)作为主信号,并添加同位素相类似性( > 0.9>0.9)作为语义相重复的附加保障. 虽然这些阈值是有意严格的,但创作道词的内在多样性意味着在这一步中只有0.6%的道被去除.

blocks.en: C.2 Writing Prompts Dataset
blocks.zh: C.2 写入提示数据集

blocks.en: The writing prompts are obtained from the WritingPrompts ( Fan et al., 2018 ) dataset. We first filter prompts based on the human-assigned popularity scores in the dataset. We assume that strong community engagement, in the form of upvotes and substantive story responses, serves as a proxy for prompt quality and narrative potential. Therefore, we retain prompts with a post score greater than 5, more than two comments, and at least one comment with a score greater than 2. To identify and remove similar prompts, we compute normalized sentence embeddings using all-mpnet-base-v2 ( Song et al., 2020 ; Reimers and Gurevych, 2019 ) and compute pairwise cosine similarities between all prompt embeddings. For prompt pairs with cosine similarity greater than 0.55, we remove one prompt from the pair. Examples of semantically similar prompts identified during this stage are shown in Figure S1 .
blocks.zh: 作文提示取自作文Prompts (Fan等,2018.)数据集. 我们首先根据数据集中 人为分配的受欢迎分数过滤提示 我们假定,社区以投票和实质性报道回应的形式进行强有力的参与,是迅速提供质量和叙述潜力的代名词。 因此,我们保留有超过5分的帖子,有超过2个评论,至少有1个评论有超过2分. 为了识别并去除相类似的提示,我们使用All-mpnet-base-v2来计算普通句嵌入(Song等,2020;Reimers和Gurevich,2019),并计算出所有即时嵌入的双智相通. 对于余弦相近度大于0.55的正弦对,我们从正弦对中去掉一对正弦. 图S1显示了在这一阶段所发现的极为相近的提示。

blocks.en: Figure S1: Examples of semantically similar prompts identified during deduplication.
blocks.zh: 图S1:在分解过程中发现的类似提示的例子。

blocks.en: To prevent the dataset from being biased toward specific genres, tones, or styles, we design a balanced sampling pipeline. We prompt the judge LLM to classify prompts into one of three categories: constrained, implied, or open-ended. For prompts labeled as constrained or implied, the judge additionally assigns the corresponding genre, style, or tone labels. Finally, the judge is asked to assess prompt validity in order to remove prompts that cannot be meaningfully answered by a language model. Examples of invalid prompts include instructions that depend on external or unavailable context, such as “Instead of this title, take any title from your Reddit frontpage as prompt” or “Write a story about this pic that made the front page of Reddit.” The final dataset is then constructed by uniformly sampling valid prompts across the identified genres, styles, and tones to ensure balanced representation.
blocks.zh: 为了防止数据集偏向于特定的流派,音调或风格,我们设计了一个平衡的采样管道. 我们促使法官LLM将提示分为三类:受约束、暗示或无限期。 对于被标记为受约束或被暗示的提示,法官会额外指定相应的流派,风格,或音调标签. 最后,要求法官评估及时的有效性,以便去除无法用语言模型有意义地回答的提示. 无效提示的例子包括取决于外部或不可用上下文的指令,例如“代替此标题,从您 Reddit 前页取出任何标题为即时 ” 或“ 写出关于这幅图片的故事, 使 Reddit 成为了首页 ” 。 然后,最后数据集通过在所查明的流派、风格和声调之间统一取样的有效提示来构建,以确保均衡的表述。

blocks.en: Appendix D Quality Metrics
blocks.zh: 附录D 质量 计量

blocks.en:
The quality metrics used during training are prompt adherence, meta-commentary, and completeness. We use Gemma-3-12b-it as a judge to evaluate these metrics ( Gemma Team, 2025 ) . The judge is prompted with a structured system message defining evaluation criteria and a required JSON output format, ensuring consistent and parsable responses.
Prompt adherence assesses whether the generated story satisfies the essential requirements specified in the prompt, including characters, setting, constraints, and stylistic elements (if explicitly stated). Meta-commentary captures the presence of undesirable meta-textual content, defined as any content that falls outside the narrative itself. This includes statements about the story (e.g., “Here is your story”, “In this story I will”) and comments directed at the user. Completeness evaluates whether the story forms a coherent and self-contained narrative. A complete story should have a clear beginning, development, and resolution. Outputs are penalized if they are truncated or end abruptly (e.g., mid-sentence or mid-scene). In addition to the LLM judge, we apply rule-based checks for meta-commentary and completeness. The meta-commentary check searches directly for common meta-textual phrases identified empirically, such as “Is there anything else I can help you with?”. The completeness check uses a simple punctuation heuristic, flagging outputs that do not end with a punctuation mark as incomplete. For each of these metrics, an output is marked as failing if either the LLM judge or the corresponding rule-based check detects a violation. All three metrics are binary, i.e., a score of 1 indicates the desired behavior, while a score of 0 indicates failure.
blocks.zh:
培训中使用的质量衡量标准是及时遵守、元注释和完整性。 我们用Gemma-3-12b-it作为评委来评价这些衡量标准(Gemma Team,2025). 法官受到一个结构化的系统信息的激励,该信息界定了评价标准和所需的JSON产出格式,确保了一致和可解答的答复。
迅速遵守评估生成的故事是否满足了即时规定的基本要求,包括人物、设置、限制和结构要素(如果有明确规定的话)。 Meta-commentary捕捉到不可取的元文字内容的存在,被定义为任何不属于叙述本身的内容. 其中包括关于该故事的说明(例如,“这里就是你的故事”,“在这个故事里我会的”)和针对用户的评论。 完整性评价故事是否形成连贯而自成一体的叙述. 一个完整的故事应该有一个明确的开端、发展和解决。 产出如被截断或突然终止(如中刑或中场),将受到惩罚。 除了LLM法官外,我们采用基于规则的检查方法来进行元评分和完整性. 元注释检查直接搜索从经验中识别出的共同元文字短语,例如“还有什么我可以帮你的吗?” 完整性检查使用简单的平分热度,标出不以平分标记为不完整而结束的输出. 如果 LLM 法官或相应的基于规则的检查发现有违章行为,则每个参数的输出都会被标记为失败. 所有三个度量衡都是二进制,即1分表示所期望的行为,而0分表示失败.

blocks.en: An output is classified as malformed if it violates basic structural or linguistic quality criteria. Specifically, we flag outputs that are insufficient in length (fewer than 50 words), exhibit low lexical diversity (a unique-token ratio below 30%), or contain formatting artifacts. Formatting artifacts include special token leakage (e.g., <|im_end|> , <|endoftext|> ) as well as HTML or CSS fragments indicative of formatting corruption (e.g., font-size , font-weight ). Furthermore, we prompt the judge to assign binary scores for coherence and grammatical correctness. Outputs receiving a score of 0 on either metric are counted as malformed.

blocks.en: Appendix G LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation Based on Human Labels
blocks.zh: 附录G LLM-as-a-法官根据人名标签进行评价

blocks.en: The use of LLM-as-a-judge is an active area of methodological debate. Prior work has shown that LLM judges can approximate human preferences at scale, but can also be vulnerable to issues such as position and verbosity bias ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Gu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ) . To validate our evaluator, we manually annotate 100 samples, corresponding to 10% of the 1000-sample test set. We annotate all samples for prompt adherence, completeness, meta-commentary, genre, style, and tone. We report both inter-annotator agreement and human-LLM agreement (Table S3 ). Overall, human-human (91.6%) and judge-human (89.9%) agreement rates overlap significantly. Notably, inter-human agreement is substantially higher for the quality-related metrics than for the diversity-related metrics. This is expected, as judgments of genre, tone, and style are more subjective and may allow for several reasonable interpretations. For the quality-related metrics, judge-human agreement is slightly lower than inter-human agreement, indicating that the judge does not fully reproduce the relatively strong consensus among human annotators. In contrast, for the diversity-related metrics, judge-human agreement is slightly higher than inter-human agreement. Because judge-human agreement is measured against the aggregate human judgment, rather than against each individual annotator, aggregation can reduce annotator-specific variation. The judge may therefore agree more closely with the human consensus than individual humans agree with one another, particularly on the more subjective diversity-related metrics.
blocks.zh: 使用LLM-as-a-judge是方法辩论的一个积极领域. 先前的研究表明,LLM评委可以大规模估计人类偏好,但也容易受到立场和动词偏好等问题的影响(郑等,2023;顾等,2025;李等,2025a.). 为了验证我们的评估者 我们手动对100个样本进行注释 相当于1000个样本测试的10% 我们对所有样本进行注释,以便迅速坚持、完整、元分析、流派、风格和语气。 我们既报告通知人之间的协议,也报告人与LLM协议(表S3)。 总体而言,人与人(91.6%)和法官与人(89.9%)的协议率相重叠很大。 值得注意的是,与质量有关的衡量标准比与多样性有关的衡量标准要高得多。 由于对流派,语气和风格的判断比较主观,并可能允许若干合理的解释,因此这是预期的. 对于与质量相关的衡量标准,法官与人之间的协议略低于人与人之间的协议,这表明法官没有完全复制人与人之间相对强烈的共识. 相比之下,对于与多样性有关的衡量标准,法官与人类之间的协议略高于人类之间的协议。 由于法官与人类之间的一致意见是以人类的总体判断来衡量的,而不是以每个个体的注释者来衡量的,汇总可以减少注释者特有的差异. 因此,法官可能更密切地赞同人类共识,而不是个人彼此同意,特别是在与多样性有关的主观衡量标准方面。

blocks.en: Appendix K Decoding Temperature Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录 K 解码 温度分析

blocks.en: The decoding temperature T T is a hyperparameter that controls output randomness and is commonly used to increase diversity and creativity in LLM outputs ( Peeperkorn et al., 2024 ; Troshin et al., 2025 ) . It modifies the token probability distribution by scaling the logits before softmax normalization ( Keskar et al., 2019 ; Renze, 2024 ) . Values of T > 1 T>1 flatten the distribution, increasing the probability of sampling lower-ranked tokens. To evaluate the performance of our model under different decoding temperatures, we compute the diversity metrics on the test set for T ∈ { 0.8 , 0.9 , 1.0 , 1.1 , 1.2 } T\in\{0.8,0.9,1.0,1.1,1.2\} and compare the results with the INS model. Higher values of T T lead to a similar increase in cosine distance for both the INS and DivLM models, while the gap between them remains consistent across the evaluated range (Table S6 ). Similar results are observed for the mean diversity reward (Figure S7 ). The DivLM model maintains substantially higher diversity at every temperature. Notably, the INS model at T = 1.2 T=1.2 does not approach the diversity reward and semantic distance achieved by the DivLM model at T = 0.8 T=0.8 , which indicates that increasing decoding temperature alone is insufficient to obtain comparable levels of diversity. The complete diversity results for DivLM at different values of T T are depicted in Figure S8 ). We observe a slight increase in named entity, style, and tone diversity at higher temperatures, while genre diversity remains largely unchanged.

blocks.en: Appendix M Length Penalty
blocks.zh: 附录M 长度 惩罚

blocks.en: We observe that RL training may result in shorter model outputs. Although our task does not have an ideal output length, keeping the average output length consistent is necessary for fair comparison, as output length can directly affect evaluation metrics. To mitigate this effect, we apply a length penalty to the GRPO reward with the goal of maintaining output lengths comparable to those of the INS model. An alternative approach would be to compute length-normalized metrics; however, metrics evaluated by LLM-based judges cannot be reliably length-normalized. Thus, we opt to explicitly regulate output length during training rather than normalizing evaluation metrics. We do acknowledge that variation in output length can itself be a form of diversity and may be sometimes desirable.
blocks.zh: 我们注意到,远程培训培训可能导致模型产出缩短。 虽然我们的任务没有理想的产出长度,但保持平均产出长度的一致性对于公平比较是必要的,因为产出长度会直接影响评价的衡量标准. 为了减轻这种影响,我们对GRPO奖励实行长罚,目的是保持产出长度与INS模型相仿. 另一种办法是计算长度正常度的计量标准;然而,基于LLM的法官所评价的计量标准不能可靠地做到长度正常。 因此,我们选择明确规范培训期间的产出长度,而不是使评价指标正常化。 我们确实承认,产出长度的变化本身可以是多样性的一种形式,有时可能是可取的。
